settings.title: Education
settings.body: OCN-accredited Level 1 & 2 training in sustainable manufacturing — a nationally recognised qualification, earned hands-on.

settings.title: Employment
settings.body: Routes into sustainable transport, manufacturing and composites — with growing employer links and support into work on release.

settings.title: Rehabilitation
settings.body: Therapeutic, focused making builds patience and resilience — and strengthens family connection through Build to Bond.

settings.title: Build or own a bike
settings.body: Book a workshop or buy a kit. Every purchase helps fund our prison and education programmes.

settings.title: Work with us
settings.body: Programmes for prisons, schools and colleges. OCN Level 2 accredited, with a self-delivery model for prisons.

settings.title: Fund or champion
settings.body: Fund a cohort, offer placements, or champion our work. £11.41 of social value for every £1 invested.
